protocol_differences: Qwen replaces Gemini per user instruction
Video input is 1fps JPEG frame sequences with 768px maximum side, max 240 seconds; not native Gemini video upload
PyTorch 2.5.1+cu121 reused rather than upstream torch2.4; transformers4.49 and timm1.0.13 override conflicting transitive metadata
Native formulas/rubrics preserved; exceptions invalidate scores; no overall score while metrics are incomplete
Unpublished GroundedSAM2Tracker, SimpleSlidingCaptioner, and MonST3RProcessor interfaces reconstructed using local/official source, not claimed author originals
Action tracking: GroundingDINO Swin-T OGC, SAM2.1-Large; first-frame highest-confidence box at box0.25/text0.30; temporal-union crop with10% margin; independently component-tested
Step1X original i1258 weights,28steps,1024size,cfg6 retained; CPU/GPU offload enabled for40GB GPU; local source uses SDPA
KaLM exact v2 retained; attention backend SDPA instead of upstream flash_attention_2; override MSVBENCH_KALM_ATTN supported
MonST3R official source, CroCo pinned; official default batchified geometry alignment, same300steps/flow and temporal objectives; wrapper sampling and quaternion export recorded per run
Real DeepFace/VGG-Face uses separate Python3.11 TensorFlow2.15.1 worker with original verify args/results; animation full metric and real model component verified
One-shot continuation validates only public fixture videos; successful smoke tests do not constitute complete20-story benchmarking

ShareCaptioner uses its original eager attention backend instead of FlashAttention2; final complete checkpoint must match all942 model tensors including389 vision tensors; initialization does not fetch redundant CLIP weights

ShareCaptioner official checkpoint omits CLIP pooled-output post_layernorm; replace unused pooled-only norm with Identity to match942 checkpoint tensors. Captioner exclusively uses pre-pool hidden_states[-1] patch features; those are unchanged.
